body: Merged main (e0cb0049) to resolve conflicts. One file conflicted: `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs` re-export lines - kept both sides (main's `check_theme`/`HolderPick` lines, this branch's `set_wcs` additions `BoxPoint, OriginAt, place_setup_origin`). Targeted gate: `cargo check -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` clean; `orient_dropdowns` 9/9, `align_axes` 9/9 (app), ui `--lib structural setup_picks_disarm` 12/12. Merge commit d1155b32. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

This conflicts with main again, and this one needs the author's judgement rather than an automated keep-both-sides: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`. Since your last merge of main (e0cb0049), #1114 restructured the Setups page and moved the WCS/orientation picker call sites - the same block this branch edits (it adds `setup_orient_pick::section` + `setup_wcs_pick::picker` calls where #1114 deleted/relocated them). Please `git merge upstream/main` and place the merged dropdown section into the new page structure; `/resolve-conflicts` (contributor mode) does the merge mechanics.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (pick.rs, pick/align.rs, axis_pick.rs, plane_pick.rs, pages.rs, setup_pages.rs, structural.rs: keep both sides; the Setups overview keeps main's setups-only layout, the orientation section stays on each setup's own page; the #701 WCS-pick draft is disarmed/paused alongside the new cylinder and origin drafts; fix commit: main's setups_declutter and plane_face_lay tests follow the orientation dropdowns). Targeted gate: camcraft-app orient_dropdowns 9, align_axes 9, axis_align 10, plane_align 9, points_align 8, turn_pivot 5 ok; camcraft-ui lib 641 passed, 0 failed; clippy -D warnings clean on camcraft-app and camcraft-ui. This is a merge-time refresh by the maintainer's merging session; a review of the refreshed head follows.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 11ecca2e1d546203da9a9fcf352bf13e3d9efadf -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (full review of head 11ecca2e, trial-merged with current main; draft state left alone).

**What looks good**
- Refresh checked via `--remerge-diff` of the merge: nothing of main's WCS pick was dropped. `plane_pick::arm`, `points_pick::arm`, `axis_pick::arm`, `cylinder_pick::arm`, `origin_pick::arm` all call `wcs_pick::disarm`; `wcs_pick::arm` clears `cylinder_pick` and `origin_pick`; `axis_pick::disarm_hidden` pauses cylinder, origin and wcs drafts (axis_pick.rs:153-160). One draft at a time holds.
- `setup_pages.rs` keeps the orientation section plus main's `wcs_pick_row::row` (#701). The old plane/points/axis rows are reachable through the dropdowns (Axes default, Points, Face, Manual, Cylinder angle), each drawn by its own row function. Every apply path queues a `CommandKind` (`AlignPartCylinder`, `PlaceSetupOrigin`, existing align commands) onto `AlignPartToSetup` / `SetWcsOrigin` with apply/invert; the UI writes no world state (setup_orient_pick.rs, cylinder_pick.rs, origin_pick.rs).
- Cylinder pick refuses degenerate input by name (flat face, edge, NaN angle, mixed patch); no unwrap/expect/panic in the new UI or `pick/cylinder.rs`.
- WCS: no second G54-G59 derivation; the origin side only calls `SetWcsOrigin::for_setup` (per setup, rotation kept).
- No snapshot PNG, no Cargo.toml / .github / build.rs / script changes, no new dependency. Decision file `docs/decisions/771-orient-dropdowns.md` present. New files under 400 lines (setup_orient_pick.rs 317, cylinder.rs 262).
- The fix commit's test edits still guard what they did: `setups_declutter` now lists `Plane orientation`, `Part axes`, `Work offset` as absent from the Setups overview (the old "Part alignment" / "Lay on a plane" headings no longer exist; the section's own heading and the axes rows replace them). `plane_face_lay` now opens the plane dropdown and selects Face before the unchanged "Pick a face" click and the unchanged flat-lay assertions.

**Local results (merged with main 44ae1271)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test orient_dropdowns` | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui, whole lib incl. structural, setups_declutter, plane_face_lay, setup_picks_disarm, wcs_pick) | 641 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-D warnings`: camcraft-ui `--all-targets`; camcraft-app `--lib --test orient_dropdowns` | clean |
| clippy `camcraft-app --all-targets` | fails, not from this PR (see note 1) |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. On main (44ae1271) `crates/app/tests/coarse_rims.rs:119` does not compile: `missing field 'cutting' in initializer of Tool` (E0063). The file is untouched by this PR; it looks like a semantic clash between #1338 and #1076 on main, and it will break any app `--all-targets` gate there.
2. The PR body still says the section is mounted on the Setups overview too; after the refresh it is on each setup's own page only (main moved the alignment pickers off the overview; `pages.rs` was taken from main). The description should be updated. Nothing the PR needs was lost.
3. The PR description carries no before/after screenshots of the UI change (the maintainer asks for them on UI PRs).
4. Dropdown method choice persists per egui session only (already stated in the body).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The review of the refreshed head is clean. Before this merges the maintainer asks for before/after screenshots of the UI change in the PR description (the setup page with the orientation dropdowns, and what it looked like before) - in the description only, never snapshot PNGs in the branch. Note also that the description says the section is on the Setups overview; since main's 59fc26b6 it is on each setup's own page only, so that sentence should be corrected.
